newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Dec 31.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Ruling Democratic Party wins in Sunday's by-elections in Korhogo and Seguela show it has started regaining ground lost to Rally of the Republicans (RDR) opposition in the north, its general-secretary Laurent Dona Fologo says. - Ivory Coast's commercial capital will get a trade exhibition park in 1997, Commerce Minister Nicolas Akon Kouassi says LA VOIE - Ivorian Popular Front (FPI) defeats ruling party in centre-west Gagnoa region in Sunday's by-elections LE JOUR - Ivorian government makes 34.5 billion CFA from all-but complete sale of its Palmindustrie agro-industrial giant, which it divided up for privatisation; Ivorian-based consortium PALMCI takes over lion's share of its plantations.
